text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - Overall direct Japanese investment in Slovakia is expected to total around one billion crowns by the end of this year.
- Trade volume between Japan and Slovakia totalled 3.6 billion crowns in the first eight months of this year, with Slovakia's deficit of around 2.9 billion crowns caused mainly by car imports.

- The overall volume of investments in Slovakia increased by 36 percent year-on-year in the first half of this year, compared with a 13 percent increase in the neighbouring Czech Republic, Finance Minister Sergej Kozlik said.
- Austria-based insurer EA-Generali AG said it would soon open a Slovak subsidiary, with basic capital of 184 million crowns.
- Some 141,897 orders to sell privatisation bonds have been registered on the over-the-counter bourse since the beginning of trading in August. Demand for the bonds is still very low.

- Viliam Vaskovic, an economic expert from the opposition Democratic Union (DU), said the National Property Fund (NPF), the state's privatisation agency, will not be able to repay privatisation bonds on their maturity date in 2001 due to liquidity problems.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Slovak police have caught 2,824 persons attempting to illegaly enter Slovakia since the beginning of this year.
